Only approved rulings appear here; open items are listed in docs/task8/APPROVAL_REGISTER.md.

sections.Progression / notes: Counterburst deals 60 / 70 / 80% of normal attack damage by Flaroo / Blazynx / Infernox, plus 0 / 5 / 10 / 15 percentage points by mastery. Normal type, damage-reduction and shield mitigation applies. No status or splash.

sections.Trigger / eligibility: Completed official rushing attempts only. Three qualifying charges ignite for a future rushing carry. No receiving, returns or two-point charge/activation. A rushing attempt qualifies when its net gain exceeds the form threshold: Flaroo over 7 yards, Blazynx over 4 yards, Infernox any positive gain (whole yards: at least 8 / 5 / 1).
sections.Core resolution: First eligible tackle begins one tackle encounter. Snapshot all defenders already within tackling reach, break their attempts, spend ignition; later arrivals can tackle normally. No one-second window. Consuming carry earns no new charge. Normal strip/fumble rules remain. Do not copy old Eruption's defender stun.

sections.Lifetime / persistence: Created field lasts 1 / 1 / 2 / 2 participating offensive scrimmage plays by mastery, counting its creation play, for both forms. Created field clears at halftime. Pending creation carries through halftime under its approved carryover rule.
sections.Progression / notes: Approved Light field exposure cadence finalized in closeout10. Lifetime by mastery as above; placement and creator cooldown as approved.

Quickened strength +0 / +3 / +6 / +9 percentage points by mastery. Kickoffs are live plays using existing movement, blocking and tackling, so the Quickened coverage teammate's speed and acceleration take real effect; actual participants and return events are credited. Punts, field goals and extra points keep their approved scope.

sections.Recharge / frequency: One counter per Clash, committed at eligible miss. While the counter is unused, each enemy normal attack against the active, able Umbrikit / Obscurat has an explicit 15% / 20% chance to miss entirely (one roll for the whole attack); explicitly undodgeable attacks bypass it without a roll. The dodge ends once the counter is used. No universal evasion is implied.

sections.Trigger / eligibility: Direct enemy normal attack missing source completely earns one trick. Every hit of multihit attack must miss. Reactions cannot earn trick. While no trick is stored, each enemy normal attack against the active Enigmane has an explicit 15% chance to strike an afterimage and miss entirely (one roll for the whole attack); explicitly undodgeable attacks bypass it without a roll.

rules.rule: Ability values given only by mastery apply equally across forms unless an explicit approved form exception exists.

Ordinary attacks connect. Misses arise only from explicit effects (Heat Mirage decoy, Snowbank Shot launch accuracy, Shadow Pounce dodge, Mind Game afterimage). Contract phrases such as 'normal evasion', 'normal dodge' or 'standard evasion' mean 'any explicit miss effect that applies'. There is no universal evasion system.

Ordinary bench attacks are removed; explicit reserve abilities remain. Voluntary rotation occurs after both normal turns and before delayed impacts, at most once per side every four exchanges. The entrant acts next exchange; on its first normal turn after a voluntary rotation its damage multipliers, heals, shields and status-application chances are halved. A Stunned skip consumes that penalty. Entry effects, reactions and defensive effects are unchanged; nonnumeric effects remain usable. Knockout replacements and forced rotations carry no penalty. Explicit ability exceptions are preserved.
Kickoffs are live plays using existing movement, blocking and tackling; actual participants and return events are credited. Punts, field goals and extra points keep their approved formula scope.

One pancake attempt per OL per play, eligible only from an established block advantage. Success applies Knocked Down through the shared gate for the rest of the play. On failure Awareness decides recovery: a recovered failure keeps the block; an unrecovered failure ends the engagement and attempts Stumbled through the shared gate. Constants pending approval.
Implement only currently approved rest-of-play football Stunned sources. Multi-play football Stunned is unapproved.
TE contested catching uses the approved Agility-based role; TE Strength adds nothing to contested catches. WR Strength remains the approved contested-catch contributor.
AI may start a Basic when it is the best eligible individual; no rarity penalty in lineup choice.
Separate collection achievements for the original 72 families, the 120 Basic families, and all 192 families. Evolutions add no family count.

Simultaneous-effect limits are diagnostics only. Never cancel, delay or delete a legitimate effect because a limit is exceeded; log a diagnostic and fail the test suite. Verified limits pending approval.
Art refinement remains paused. Both runtime-backed ability reviewers (football and Beast Clash) remain required.
